'''PD-44''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Taral V]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was destroyed around [[3642 BBY]].
